div.head: II Cn 53
div.ab: Gif be cwicum ceorle wif hi be oðrum were forlicge, ⁊ hit open weorðe, geweorðe heo to woruldsceame syððan hyre sylfre, ⁊ hæbbe se rihtwer eall þæt heo ahte; ⁊ heo þolige nasa ⁊ earena.
Gif be cwycum ceorle wif hig be oðrum were forligce, ⁊ hit open weorðe, geweorðe heo to weruldscame siððan hyre sylfre; ⁊ hæbbe se rihtwer eall þæt hyeo ahte; ⁊ heo þolige nase ⁊ earena.
Si mulier, uiuente marito suo, faciat adulterium, et manifestetur, fiat (sit) ad dedecus seculi postea sibi ipsi, et habeat legalis maritus eius omne quod ipsa habebat; et ipsa perdat nasum et aures.

Ðæt nan wif heo ne forlicgge. Gyf be cwicum ceorle wif hig be oðrum were forlicge, ⁊ hit open wyrðe, gewyrðe heo to woruldsceame syððan hyre sylfre, ⁊ hæbbe se rihtwere eall þæt heo age, ⁊ heo ðonne ðolie ægðer ge nosu ge ða earan.

No woman shall commit adultery. If, while her husband is still alive, a woman commits adultery with another man and it is discovered, she shall bring disgrace upon herself, and her lawful husband shall have all that she possesses, and she shall then lose both her nose and her ears.

(Dass kein Eheweib hure. B) Wenn bei Lebzeiten des Ehemanns eine Ehefrau mit anderem Manne hurt, und dies unleugbar wird, so werde sie dann sich selbst zur Schande vor den Menschen, und erhalte der Ehemann alles was sie besass (besitzt B); und sie verliere (dann beides, B) Nase und (wie B) Ohren.

(That no wife should whore. B) If, in her husband's lifetime, a wife whores with another man, and this becomes undeniable, let her then become a shame before men to herself, and let the husband receive all that she possessed (possesses, B); and let her lose (then both, B) nose and (as well as, B) ears.
